2026_03_NYJ_DET.headline: Detroit’s offensive balance challenges a Jets defense that must win before the catch
2026_03_NYJ_DET.paragraph1: Detroit can stress New York by forcing the Jets to defend the full width of the field while maintaining enough rushing efficiency to keep play-action credible. The Jets need their front to create disruption without sacrificing coverage integrity, because Detroit is comfortable turning short completions into efficient drives. On offense, New York cannot afford repeated long-yardage situations against a Lions defense that can attack predictable protections. Sustained possessions and red-zone finishing are essential to keeping pace.
2026_03_NYJ_DET.model_rationale: Detroit’s balance can force New York to defend every level, while the Jets need early-down disruption and sustained offensive possessions to prevent the game from becoming one-sided.
